name: Gompu's Bar & Restaurant
why_it_matters: One of Kalimpong's oldest hotel-restaurants — sources put the founding in the early 1900s and the family has been making momos for over six decades. Sits just above the busy Kalimpong taxi stand. Pork and chicken momos are the standing-order; thukpa is made on request, including for kids.
insider_tip: Ground-floor seating is plain and crowded; the dining hall fills fast for breakfast (8-10am). Eight pork momos plus one tingmo with shyapta is the local order.
signature_address: Ground floor, Hotel Gompu's, Main Road, near Bus Stand, Chotta Bhalukhop, Kalimpong 734301

name: Cafe Kalimpong
why_it_matters: Opened 2017 on the eastern hill leading up to Durpin Monastery — about a 10-minute drive from the main town but deliberately secluded. Kalimpong's only sit-down café with proper espresso machines and a Kanchenjunga-facing terrace.
insider_tip: Drive or share a taxi up — uphill walk from town is steep (45 minutes). Sunset slot (4-6pm) clouds in often; the morning view from 9am is more reliable.
signature_address: East Main Road, Durpin Hill, Kalimpong 734301

name: King Thai Hotel & Restaurant
why_it_matters: Second-floor restaurant on Main Road in Thanadara — Kalimpong's only Thai kitchen. Run by a family that travelled to Bangkok to learn the curries; the Pan-Asian menu plus Bengali/Nepali backup makes it the safe sit-down dinner for groups with mixed preferences.
insider_tip: Climb to the 2nd floor — the entrance off Main Road is unsigned and easy to miss. Tom yum and red curry are reliable; skip the Bengali items, which are an afterthought.
signature_address: 2nd Floor, Maa Supermarket, Main Road, Thanadara, Kalimpong 734301

name: 3C's Cafe
why_it_matters: One of Kalimpong's earliest cafes; runs its own in-house bakery factory where every cake, biscuit and bread sold here is made. The proprietor is a town fixture and chats up regulars personally.
insider_tip: Stock for breads and pastries gets thin by 5pm — go in the morning if you want a full counter. Walnut bread is the local favourite; ask if it's been baked that day.
signature_address: Shahid Dal Bahadur Giri Road, Kalimpong 734316

name: Cafe Refuel
why_it_matters: Motorbike-themed café on the State Highway 12 stretch out of Kalimpong; the only place locally pulling Vietnamese-style chicken wings and pizzas with table football and a karaoke setup. Popular as a late-evening hangout for younger Kalimpong residents.
insider_tip: It's at the 9th Mile marker — about 15 minutes by taxi from the main bazaar. Wings get the kitchen's full attention; burgers can be uneven on weekends.
signature_address: 9th Mile, Near Engine Dara, State Highway 12, Khasmahal, Kalimpong 734301
